checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=39 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.66 tightness=0.7 base_volume_vs_leg=0.53 base_volume_vs_avg=0.86
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 39 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.66 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 2.0% vs its 20-SMA, -0.3% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)
first leg of 22.7% in 9 sessions: his '15% plus in 10 days or less'

claude.reason: Three recorded FAILs — C (base 39 sessions, giveback 0.66), RE (burst bar only 85% of the prior 5-bar range), and VOL (volume below prior session and below the 50-session average, with the catalyst-volume requirement triggered by the 39-session base) — pull this well below A quality. The chart confirms the base problem visually: the shaded box spans roughly August through late September, a long declining drift from ~275 down to ~248 with wide overlapping red and green bars throughout, not a tight orderly consolidation. The signal bar itself is modest and not range-expanding, consistent with the RE and VOL failures.
claude.key_risk: The base is a prolonged declining consolidation with heavy overhead supply from the prior high near 280, meaning any follow-through faces immediate resistance from weeks of prior trading above the signal close.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps below the signal day's close of 256.29 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest above the open, confirming the weak volume and range-expansion failure.
